system.name: OpenMarcie
system.one_liner: The largest open multimodal dataset for worker action recognition in industrial assembly, with wearable and room sensors and three benchmark tasks.

content.variant_note: a text-only dashboard in three bands: applications and requirements, two assembly scenarios, data sources and validation tasks
content.argues: Industrial applications set requirements that shape two assembly scenarios, a rich multimodal collection and a validation on three tasks.
content.subject: Application areas, dataset requirements, a bicycle and a 3D-printer scenario, the sensor modalities collected and the validation tasks.

lessons.what_to_learn: A dataset paper with no striking images can still carry its Figure 1 with three stacked bands, why, what and how it is checked, joined by two big chevrons, one accent colour on pale blue, and black silhouettes to tell the scenarios apart.
lessons.suits: Dataset or benchmark papers in applied domains such as industry, medicine or robotics that need a structured description rather than sample images.

evidence: Caption: top shows applications, middle shows two assembly scenarios, bottom shows data collection with over 200 channels and three benchmarks.
Section 2: two settings, ad-hoc bicycle assembly and procedural 3D printer assembly, are shown in Figure 1.

summary: OpenMarcie is a large multimodal dataset for recognising worker actions in industrial assembly, recorded with wearable and room sensors in two scenarios. Figure 1 is a text-only dashboard in three stacked bands. In the top band, three application areas, each with a circle icon and a dark bar of tasks, lead by a big chevron to a table of dataset requirements with nested arcs. The middle band holds two grey cards, ad-hoc bicycle assembly and procedural 3D printer assembly, with bullet lists and black silhouettes. The bottom band lists the data sources in a four-column table, then a second chevron leads to a small tree of three validation tasks. Dark teal on pale blue, sans type.
